name: Zomato Blinkit
description: Search products, manage cart, and place grocery orders on Blinkit (by Zomato)
author: flock

requires.description: Log in to Blinkit via the dashboard browser session to access grocery delivery
requires.rationale: Blinkit has no public API — a saved browser session is how the agent shops on your behalf.

browser.setup_instructions: Log in to your Blinkit account via the dashboard. Ensure your delivery address is set to the correct location before connecting.

checkout.reason: Drives the real site: opens the cart drawer, waits for Blinkit's payment page and its zomato.com payment frame (up to ~45s on a slow load), or waits in the payment frame for the UPI option. Killed at 30s, the owner is left with a half-opened payment page.

view-cart.reason: Loads Blinkit's home page and opens the cart drawer (there is no cart page): timed out at 30s live on 2026-10-16.

add-to-cart.reason: Opens the product page, clicks Add to cart and the + for each further unit, then reads the header cart: three browser steps with waits.

search-products.reason: Waits up to 15s for the results grid, then scrolls twice to load more cards.
